verses.text_en: And I saw other mountains, and amongst them were ⌜groves of⌝ trees, and there flowed forth from them nectar, which is named sarara and galbanum.
verses.text_hr: Vidjeh druge gore, a među njima ⌜gajeve⌝ stabala iz kojih je tekao nektar, nazvan sarara i galbanum.

verses.text_en: And beyond these mountains I saw another mountain ⌜to the east of the ends of the earth⌝, 〚whereon were aloe trees〛, and all the trees were full =of stacte=, being like almond trees.
verses.text_hr: Iza tih gora vidjeh drugu goru ⌜istočno od krajeva zemlje⌝, 〚na kojoj su rasla stabla aloje〛. Sva su stabla bila puna =stakte= i nalik bademima.

verses.text_en: And when one =burnt= it, it smelt sweeter than any fragrant odour.
verses.text_hr: Kad bi se to =zapalilo=, mirisalo je slađe od svakoga mirisa.
